code.originalText: Four-week check of potassium and creatinine, second hepatitis B vaccine, and infectious diseases consultation

text.paragraph: Four-week potassium and creatinine check, second hepatitis B vaccine, and same-day infectious diseases consultation. [S]

Mr. Ashe returns four weeks after his first visit and is seen by Dr. Rao of infectious diseases on the same day. He takes bictegravir, emtricitabine, and tenofovir alafenamide each morning and trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole twice a day, and has missed no doses. He started ezetimibe four weeks ago without muscle aches. He has had no headache, seizure, or weakness, and his right hand feels normal. He has had no rash, fever, cough, or breathlessness, and no chest pain. He is sleeping better than at the first visit and has started to coach again two afternoons a week. He has told no one new about his diagnosis and asked again that his results go only to him. [S]
